note: Screening thresholds for a first read of a filing. A value beyond a screen is a prompt to look closer, not a conclusion about the company. Edit values here; the version string is printed on every report that uses them.

sources.default: General screening levels for nonfinancial companies; set by BMG Capital for first-pass review, not from a published standard.
sources.Railcar leasing: Lessors finance long-lived, contracted railcars mostly with debt, so leverage screens sit higher; payouts above free cash flow are not screened because fleet growth capex makes free cash flow negative by design.
sources.Banking: Leverage and coverage ratios built for nonfinancial companies do not apply to banks; none are screened.
